name: Crayon Picture Book

notes.camera: Hold on a single page; use page turns to change scenes.
notes.type: Round hand-lettering; keep captions on quiet paper.

prompt: Draw a storybook page in wax crayon, building recognizable shapes from rough scribbles on textured paper. Reveal hidden details with a translucent wash that skips over the wax.

name: Watercolor Brush

notes.camera: Slow glides across one continuous painted sheet; transition with a brush-edge wash.
notes.type: Elegant serif captions and handwritten specimen notes.

prompt: Build a field journal in translucent pigment. Reveal each form stroke by stroke, let overlapping washes pool at the edges, and grow handwritten leader lines toward the painted subject.

name: Chinese Ink Wash

notes.camera: Drift across the sheet like a handscroll; use long holds around one gesture.
notes.type: Small brush-like titles and a readable serif for captions.

prompt: Use expressive ink strokes on fibrous rice paper. Let unpainted space carry distance and use spreading ink and mist to reveal mountains, waves, figures or transitions.

name: Impasto Oil Painting

notes.camera: Move slowly across the surface or push into a raised brush mark.
notes.type: Use restrained editorial labels in a quiet patch of the frame.

prompt: Compose large value shapes from thick palette-knife planes. Add directional ridges and raking light at the focal point, keeping surrounding areas calm enough for the subject to read.

name: One-line Drawing

notes.camera: Hold a clean page while the line travels; follow it only when needed.
notes.type: Minimal sans-serif text separated from the moving line.

prompt: Reveal one continuous ink path that bends into every subject. Carry a part of the old silhouette into the new one so the drawing itself connects the scenes.

name: Whiteboard Explainer

notes.camera: Pan between regions and pull back to reveal the complete diagram.
notes.type: Handwritten labels with a readable caption layer.

prompt: Teach on a single whiteboard with ink written in visible stroke order. Use arrows, moving magnets and erasable clusters to show connections instead of replacing the whole frame.

name: Shadow Puppetry

notes.camera: Keep a proscenium view; change scale by moving silhouettes toward the light.
notes.type: Frame short titles outside busy puppet silhouettes.

prompt: Stage jointed cutout puppets with lace-like openings on an illuminated cloth screen. Tilt and swing limbs around visible pivots while light leaks through colored cutouts.

name: Ukiyo-e

notes.camera: Travel along one print with shallow parallax; use a new sheet for major changes.
notes.type: Keep captions in a quiet paper margin with restrained editorial type.

prompt: Animate a woodblock-style scene with carved contours, flat pigment areas, visible paper grain and graded bokashi skies. Give waves, rain and textiles repeated carved marks.

name: Red Paper-cut

notes.camera: Alternate between a flat overhead tableau and small pushes into the cutwork.
notes.type: Place short readable copy in open cream space.

prompt: Construct a festive world from connected red paper shapes and negative-space cutouts. Rotate pieces at paper hinges and use symmetrical openings to reveal detail.

name: Paper-cut Lightbox

notes.camera: Move through the layers with gentle macro parallax; occasionally pull back to show the box.
notes.type: Use short captions outside glowing openings.

prompt: Build a shallow lightbox from several cut-card layers, with soft shadows and a warm light behind the deepest sheet. Put bright windows or moons in actual cutouts.

name: Risograph Print

notes.camera: Reveal one plate at a time; keep the printed sheet steady for reading.
notes.type: Use punchy display type and compact zine-style notes.

prompt: Create each frame from two or three translucent stencil inks over warm paper. Allow small registration offsets, halftone grain and darker overprints where inks meet.

name: Halftone Dossier

notes.camera: Snap between evidence panels, then pause on each exhibit label.
notes.type: Heavy condensed headings, small monospaced exhibit IDs.

prompt: Present the story as a case file whose exhibits land one at a time. Use flat ink fills, coarse halftones, thick silhouettes, rubber stamps and offset headline shadows.

name: Woodcut Print

notes.camera: Use slow reveals that expose gouges and broad silhouettes.
notes.type: Strong carved-looking headlines with plain readable captions.

prompt: Make the picture appear carved from a near-black block. Reveal highlights as irregular cuts, vary the hatch direction by surface and use a single accent for the crucial object.

name: Swiss Motion Graphics

notes.camera: Use precise translations and mask reveals rather than floating camera moves.
notes.type: Flush-left typography with a strong size hierarchy.

prompt: Use a strict modular grid, one sans-serif family and a signal color. Animate exact alignments and grid-sized shifts, with a single hierarchy change per beat.

name: 60s Spy Title Sequence

notes.camera: Cut on sharp musical accents and alternate wides with graphic close-ups.
notes.type: Large geometric credits are part of the scenery.

prompt: Build a mid-century title sequence out of cut-paper silhouettes and oversized letters. Let a letterform become a doorway, a shadow or part of the next composition.

name: Art Deco

notes.camera: Push along a central axis and open or close geometric shutters around it.
notes.type: Tall geometric capitals with restrained spacing.

prompt: Build a symmetrical lacquer-and-metal poster with etched lines, stepped arches, fan shapes and graded spotlights. Reveal details like bulbs lighting up one row at a time.

name: Blueprint

notes.camera: Track along the drawing as details are added; pull back for the assembly.
notes.type: Technical mono labels, units and leader lines.

prompt: Reveal an engineering drawing in drafting order, from construction guides to the finished object and dimensions. Use fine white lines and true explanatory callouts on a blue sheet.

name: Stained Glass

notes.camera: Start in shadow and follow the light across the window.
notes.type: Keep titles clear of bright glass and leadwork.

prompt: Divide the image into colored glass fragments with dark lead seams. Let a moving shaft of light uncover the story and cast colored patches onto surrounding stone.

name: Pictogram Motion

notes.camera: Use straight, beat-aligned moves and consistent framing between icons.
notes.type: Large signage text, short labels and generous spacing.

prompt: Build scenes from round-ended bars, discs and modular signage icons. Slide patterned grid cells in counterpoint and give each important action a distinct pictogram.

name: ASCII / CRT Terminal

notes.camera: Keep the screen grid fixed while character blocks scroll, blink or resolve.
notes.type: One monospace face; preserve stable character spacing.

prompt: Draw every object as actual characters on a fixed monospace grid. Vary glyph density to shade shapes and use a restrained phosphor glow and scanline overlay.

name: Data Storytelling

notes.camera: Follow the data through a pan or zoom; pull back to preserve context.
notes.type: Small handwritten notes paired with precise numeric labels.

prompt: Tell a story by drawing one chart mark at a time on cream paper. Highlight a single data point per beat with a penciled annotation; use real, labeled values and units.

name: Isometric Infographic

notes.camera: Use consistent isometric angles, opening the view only where something happens.
notes.type: Fine leader lines with high-contrast short labels.

prompt: Explain a system as an isometric diagram built from three-tone blocks. Lift lids or layers to show how components connect and encode quantities as countable marks.

name: Dark Tech Keynote

notes.camera: Push toward the relevant control, then reset to a clean centered view.
notes.type: Large clean sans-serif headings and a single brand accent.

prompt: Stage a product launch in a near-black studio with a hairline grid. Move interface cards with snap-grid precision, reveal details with soft light and reserve one large metric as the climax.

name: 1930s Rubber Hose Cartoon

notes.camera: Frame readable silhouettes, with quick poses on strong beats.
notes.type: Period-style cards for brief titles or captions.

prompt: Draw stretchy limbs and rounded black-and-white characters with a hand-inked wobble. Let props react with squash, stretch and a repeating swing rhythm.

name: 80s Cel Anime

notes.camera: Hold strong poses, pan backgrounds and punctuate with fast cuts.
notes.type: Use small retro title graphics beside readable modern captions.

prompt: Use two-tone hand-painted cels over airbrushed backgrounds with rim light and constrained animation. Add restrained tape texture while keeping faces and captions clear.

name: Sci-Fi Sitcom Toon

notes.camera: Use clear shot-reverse-shot staging; save the glowing portal for a transition.
notes.type: Bold compact lettering with a stable caption baseline.

prompt: Animate thick, slightly boiling outlines and flat colors in a space sitcom. Let contrasting reactions drive the scene and use a different restrained palette for each world.

name: 16-bit Pixel RPG

notes.camera: Track through the tile map in whole pixels; cut to clear menu close-ups.
notes.type: Crisp bitmap-style labels; allow enough time for dialogue.

prompt: Stage scenes like a 16-bit role-playing game with tile maps, indexed sprites and typewriter dialogue boxes. Keep edges pixel-perfect and use menus as part of the narrative.

name: HD-2D

notes.camera: High three-quarter views with small tilt-shift dolly moves.
notes.type: Use quiet game-style labels at a consistent scale.

prompt: Place crisp pixel sprites in a lit 3D diorama with fog, practical lamps and shadow-catching surfaces. Preserve sharp sprite pixels against selective depth blur.

name: Microgame Frenzy

notes.camera: Use short countdowns, hard cuts and increasingly short rounds.
notes.type: One oversized imperative per round; outcome text in the same place.

prompt: Cut a sequence of tiny challenges around one action verb each. Change the graphic style between rounds while keeping the prompt and outcome clear.

name: Game Show Flat

notes.camera: Land score changes and mascot reactions on a shared tempo grid.
notes.type: Fat playful labels with large, distinct scores.

prompt: Build a rhythm show from candy stripes, sunbursts and flat mascot figures. Alternate call and response, then reward each round with an unmistakable judgement word.

name: 1920s Silent Film

notes.camera: Use locked theatre framing, occasional iris transitions and deliberate title holds.
notes.type: High-contrast serif intertitles with short lines.

prompt: Use ink-and-silver-wash images inside a period projection frame. Carry story beats with intertitles and expressive posing; keep flicker and wear gentle enough to read.

name: Liminal Found Footage

notes.camera: Hold uneasy wide angles and use slow imperfect handheld drift.
notes.type: Small timestamp graphics only for fictional or known timing.

prompt: Recreate a camcorder exploring empty fluorescent corridors. Use repeating architecture, lingering unease and subtle tape defects while keeping important details visible.

name: Brick Toy

notes.camera: Shoot close at tabletop height; hold poses between small physical moves.
notes.type: Simple title cards that complement bold block colors.

prompt: Make a tactile stop-motion world of interlocking plastic bricks with visible studs. Animate held poses under a desk-lamp look and use original toy shapes.

name: Paper Pop-up Book

notes.camera: Use a tabletop macro view and page-turn transitions.
notes.type: Put readable storybook text on flat page areas.

prompt: Open a book into hinged paper stages with fold creases and shadows. Move white-bordered cutout characters among layers that stand up as the page opens.

name: Tilt-Shift Miniature

notes.camera: Use high oblique framing; keep the focus band on the subject.
notes.type: Small crisp captions outside the most blurred areas.

prompt: Present a real-looking place as a tabletop miniature using a narrow focus band, small moving figures and compressed time. Build scale cues into the scene.

name: Low-poly Isometric Island

notes.camera: Use a stable isometric camera with small glides or rotations.
notes.type: Simple rounded labels that stay separate from the terrain.

prompt: Build an orthographic island from simple geometric blocks and faceted forms. Introduce each small object with a measured bounce while keeping the diorama readable.

name: Glass Product Render

notes.camera: Slow studio orbits and a measured push through separated pieces.
notes.type: Spare product labels in dark negative space.

prompt: Light a glass object in a dark-field studio. Use transparent and frosted surfaces, thin strip-light reflections and an exploded arrangement that closes together.

name: Urban Sketch · Pen & Wash

notes.camera: Glide between buildings and details as if looking around a sketchbook.
notes.type: Small hand-lettered place names and quiet captions.

prompt: Reveal an on-location sketch with sepia pen marks that overshoot corners and loose watercolor that spills a little past the lines. Let the image fade into the grain of the page.

name: Living Screencast

notes.camera: Zoom into one control per beat and return to the wider interface for context.
notes.type: Keep UI labels sharp, with compact captions outside the interface.

prompt: Reconstruct the interface as clean, readable screen recording graphics. Give a small pixel mascot a role in showing where to click, what changed and why.

name: Mid-century Cartoon

notes.camera: Frame clear step-by-step actions and pause before each change.
notes.type: Friendly mid-century display lettering with simple instructions.

prompt: Use limited-animation flat shapes with slightly offset ink outlines. Hold character bodies steady while the hands perform each step against abstract color-block rooms.

name: Sci-fi Hologram HUD

notes.camera: Follow one scan sweep and push into the selected part before resetting.
notes.type: Thin technical mono labels with enough contrast for data.

prompt: Scan an object into a glowing wireframe, then lock targeting boxes onto relevant parts. Peel those parts out into small exploded views with legible values.

name: Copperplate Engraving

notes.camera: Hold on the plate; slide a loupe over one engraved detail.
notes.type: Small serif plate labels with fine rules.

prompt: Show an intaglio proof coming together from swelling contour strokes, hatching and cross-hatching. Reveal magnified details beside the plate and finish with a restrained wash.

name: Silkscreen Travel Poster

notes.camera: Pull in one colored layer per beat, then hold the finished poster.
notes.type: Strong destination headlines with large clean shapes.

prompt: Compose a destination or event as flat screen-printed ink layers. Use stepped tones, hard edges and small paper gaps to suggest hand registration.

name: Satellite Briefing

notes.camera: Zoom from overview to measured area through aligned layers.
notes.type: Use small but legible labels for place, unit and source.

prompt: Build a restrained analyst view with map layers, fine measurement lines and a reticle. Use provided or verified geographic data; label diagrammatic views as illustrations.

name: Engineering Briefing Board

notes.camera: Follow drawn connections across the board; pull back to reveal the decision.
notes.type: Use marker-like headings and neat evidence tags.

prompt: Stage an engineering comparison on a marker board with cutout exhibits, magnets and a ruler. Assign consistent meanings to three ink colors and tie each claim to the supplied facts.

name: LiDAR Survey

notes.camera: Use one continuous camera path through points and the revealed surface.
notes.type: Hairline instruments, units and source labels.

prompt: Move through a dark measured point cloud, then use a scan plane to reveal its solid surface and outline distances. Use supplied scans for claims or label a schematic clearly.

name: Projection on White Model

notes.camera: Orbit gently while lighting layers change; hold for each legend.
notes.type: Put precise legend labels in dark empty space.

prompt: Project data layers onto a static matte-white scale model on a dark plinth. Make each overlay behave like colored light projected onto the surfaces.

name: Data Physicalization

notes.camera: Track along the front edge of the stacks; pull back for comparison.
notes.type: Show units and sourced values beside the physical marks.

prompt: Turn quantities into countable physical units such as blocks, plates or coins. Make stack heights proportional to verified values and use studio light to reveal material differences.

name: Exploded Teardown

notes.camera: Move between layers without losing the assembly orientation.
notes.type: Pair each concise part name with its measured spec or source.

prompt: Explode a product along one assembly axis. Pause on individual components with supplied specifications, then return the layers to a single object.

name: Microscope Story

notes.camera: Keep the same visual point through magnification changes; pause when focus settles.
notes.type: Label scale, units and source without covering the specimen.

prompt: Move from a glass slide to a specimen through successive scales with careful focus sweeps. Use supplied microscopy and calibrated scale bars, or label a schematic as an illustration.

name: Archive Light Table

notes.camera: Use an overhead view with a tight insert for the magnified detail.
notes.type: Small catalogue identifiers, dates and precise quoted fragments.

prompt: Arrange archive materials on a cool backlit surface. Bring a loupe over a supplied artifact, turn a negative positive or isolate a detail while retaining the object's catalogue identity.

name: Caption News

notes.camera: Cut on strong beats but hold dates and numbers long enough to read.
notes.type: Bold condensed captions with one yellow emphasis block.

prompt: Make a social-news segment readable at a glance. Combine verified documents or supplied footage with large caption blocks, one highlighted keyword, and source tags beside figures.

name: 1920s Newsreel

notes.camera: Use period wipes, flips and irises with brisk headline beats.
notes.type: High-contrast condensed headlines and small date cards.

prompt: Stage a period newsreel with a globe ident, spinning paper headlines, map inserts and place-and-date cards. Use supplied or verified archive material for historical claims.

name: Live Countdown Split-screen

notes.camera: Keep simultaneous panels on the same clock and hold the payoff.
notes.type: Large tabular digits with clear labels for each view.

prompt: Center an event on a visible countdown. Add synchronized split-screen cells as zero approaches, then merge them to emphasize the result. Use only known timing or label a dramatization.

name: Time-lapse Symphony

notes.camera: Tighten cut intervals in stages and use a decisive closing cut.
notes.type: Keep captions sparse so motion and composition carry the sequence.

prompt: Arrange motion into a city rhythm with compressed traffic, crowds or weather. Alternate accumulating movement with one long contrasting hold; use supplied footage or an original animated city.

name: Visual Investigation

notes.camera: Use synchronized views and stable zooms that preserve orientation.
notes.type: Use legible timestamps and source tags by each exhibit.

prompt: Organize supplied evidence on a common timeline. Freeze a decisive frame, mark the relevant detail, and match it to a verified quote, map or reading. Distinguish reconstructions visibly.

name: Constructivist Montage

notes.camera: Cut sharply along a shared diagonal and land key changes on a mechanical rhythm.
notes.type: Large condensed type on diagonals with readable source text.

prompt: Build a constructivist montage from diagonal type bands, ink-and-paper textures and strong cutout shapes. Let a single red mark the key event in sourced images or illustrations.

name: Sports Telestrator

notes.camera: Give every annotation a stable freeze before resuming movement.
notes.type: Use short tactical labels and a clear frame or time readout.

prompt: Play a supplied sports clip, then freeze or rewind to mark a meaningful movement. Use arrows, rings and zones to show tactics, or build a labeled pitch diagram if footage is unavailable.

name: Broadcast News Package

notes.camera: Cut from ident to rundown, then to consistent full-frame graphics for each item.
notes.type: Keep the lower-third hierarchy steady across headlines.

prompt: Build a newsroom package with a short ident, a persistent lower third and dedicated maps, source cards and number boards. Use verified figures and clearly separate distinct items.

name: Memphis Diorama

notes.camera: Use a slow camera that gives the viewer time to scan the diorama.
notes.type: Playful rounded display type in quiet space around the frame.

prompt: Open an organic frame into a little tabletop world of saturated geometric shapes, ink contours, hard purple shadows and repeating patterns. Animate small ambient details in loops.

name: Transit Map

notes.camera: Travel along one route at a time and pull back for the full network.
notes.type: Station names follow consistent offsets from dots and route lines.

prompt: Draw a metro schematic with octilinear lines, white station dots and black-outlined interchange capsules. Use a moving pen tip to show network growth and establish route colors consistently.

name: Chalkboard

notes.camera: Use a fixed classroom view with small pushes for a formula or word.
notes.type: Chalk handwriting for labels; keep stroke width and spacing readable.

prompt: Teach one idea by writing chalk strokes in order on a textured blackboard. Write the initial idea, wipe part of it clean, and use the same space for the corrected explanation.

name: Isometric Picture Book

notes.camera: Stay with the same isometric orientation and reveal the next step with a cutaway.
notes.type: Serif labels appear on quiet floor areas with high contrast.

prompt: Explain an everyday rule through small faceless figures acting in sequence in one flat isometric place. Lift or remove walls when they hide the meaningful action.

name: Printed Long Take

notes.camera: Travel in one smooth continuous camera move without page changes.
notes.type: Use spare caption cards or clear paper margins.

prompt: Make a continuous 3D journey read as a scratchboard print. Use hatch density to show depth and weather, and reserve one red accent for a recurring subject.

name: Circuit Board

notes.camera: Follow one energized trace at a time; pull back to explain branching.
notes.type: Use small silkscreen-like labels beside the paths.

prompt: Map a system as copper traces, pads and silkscreen labels on dark green solder mask. Show what flows as moving light, then bridge between the system map and a close component view.

name: Desktop Flythrough

notes.camera: Fly in one continuous path between cards, then pull back over the whole desk.
notes.type: Keep UI labels readable and match the product's own type hierarchy.

prompt: Lay app screens out as printed cards on a sunlit desk. Use voxel-like pixel characters to connect actions from card to card and let each stop demonstrate a meaningful UI change.
